# tagging interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:taggingInterval`](gmeow-taggingInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taggingInterval>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/tags`](../../slices/tags.md)

The time interval over which the tagging act holds. A relator carries its period this way (matching [`gmeow:usageInterval`](gmeow-usageInterval.md), [`gmeow:relationshipInterval`](gmeow-relationshipInterval.md)) rather than via RDF-star annotations on the relator node.
